abstract.para: Some packages and components shipped with &suselinux; 15 have support lifecycles that do not align with the product's general Service Pack timelines.

topic.para: This article covers the complete &suselinux; 15 code stream, from 15 GA (also known as SP0) through 15 SP7.
While &suselinux; 15 features a comprehensive 13-year lifecycle, certain high-velocity packages are maintained independently.

Components like Java or Python follow distinct lifecycles, whereas tools like Go, Rust, Node.js, and GCC receive regular updates inside existing Service Packs to align with security standards and upstream releases.
For general SUSE support guidelines, see the SUSE Product Lifecycle Page.
